# Handoff Acknowledged

## Summary

| Metric | Champion | Last PASS |
|--------|----------|-----------|
| Tuning Mean | **1.904** | 1.762 |
| Tuning Min | **0.431** | 0.051 ⚠️ |
| Lockbox Mean | 1.793 | 1.793 |
| Lockbox Min | 1.134 | **1.347** |
| Worst MDD | **-9.3%** | -11.2% |

## Observations

1. **Champion holding** - Better tuning consistency and MDD control
2. **Candidate concern** - Tuning min of 0.05 indicates near-breakeven fold; fragile
3. **Lockbox parity** - Both perform similarly out-of-sample (~1.79 mean)
4. **No INCONCLUSIVE** - Pipeline is clean, no stalled evaluations

## Status
- ✅ Loop running normally (180 iterations, ~19h elapsed)
- ✅ ~29h runway remaining
- ✅ Champion stable at v5

## Next Steps
Ready to execute suggested commands when loop continues:
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --run --select-best
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml --run
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```

No intervention required. System continues autonomous search.
